name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
dlText: Set per country (mostly Aug – Dec 2026) · Pakistan closed 31 Oct 2026

eligibility.note: Citizens of about 180 countries, each with its own quota and deadline; check your country's page

nominationBody: The Swiss embassy in your country (pre-selection)

countryNotes.PK: Pakistan window was 20 Aug – 31 Oct 2026; contact islamabad.scholarships@eda.admin.ch.

note: Research stays (6–12 months) and PhD scholarships, not taught master's. Apply through the Swiss embassy for your nationality.

name: IMPRS for Intelligent Systems (IMPRS-IS) PhD
host: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Univ. Stuttgart & Univ. Tübingen
amount: Funded doctoral position (amount: check official page)
fields: Machine learning, computer vision, robotics, HCI, neuroscience
note: One intake a year; start from Feb 2027. Referees must upload their letters before the deadline, so ask them early.
nextText: Next call expected ~Oct 2027, closing ~mid-Nov 2027 (estimated from the 2026 cycle)

name: ELLIS PhD Program
host: European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems
amount: Positions are funded by the advisor's institution (terms vary; check official page)
nextText: Next call ~Oct 2027 (portal opened 1 Oct this year)
note: Decisions late Feb – Mar 2027. Some advisors' institutions have their own (earlier) deadlines, so apply there in parallel. Individual ELLIS-listed PhD jobs have separate deadlines.

name: CS@max planck Doctoral Program
host: Max Planck Graduate Center for Computer and Information Science
amount: Full financial support for admitted students (amount: check official page)
dlText: Expected 15 Dec 2026 (Fall 2027 entry) · applications open 1 Sep
tags: English test unless taught in English
note: The official overview says applications must be complete by 15 December of the previous year but isn't dated; confirm the 2026 date. Bachelor's or master's in CS or a related field.

name: EPFL EDIC Computer Science PhD Fellowship
amount: First-year IC fellowship, then PhD salary (check official page); 55 fellowships in 2027
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET (main round) · 15 Apr 2027 second round, mainly local applicants
note: Admission needs EDIC committee approval plus an IC fellowship or a lab that hires you directly. The deadline moved from 15 Dec to 1 Dec from 2026.

name: ISTA PhD Program
host: Institute of Science and Technology Austria
amount: Salary €3,053–3,673/month gross, paid 14 times a year (2026 rates); 5-year contract
fields: CS, maths, physics, biology, neuroscience, chemistry, data science
note: Interviews late Feb – early Mar 2027; offers must be accepted by 15 Apr; everyone starts 15 Sep 2027.
